purpose: Route an AI from an implementation request to exactly one product or landing guide without loading unrelated packages.
routingOrder: determine whether the requested result belongs inside a service interface or is a landing page
if that context is not explicit, ask the user and wait for the answer
follow its machineIndex and load only task-relevant catalog records

ambiguity.question: Это страница внутри интерфейса сервиса или страница/форма для лендинга?
doNotInferFrom: authentication, registration, payment or form functionality

implementationProvider.requiredAction: Use an existing compatible local layer or, when it is absent, download the pinned release, verify its checksum and copy layers/courses into the product project before implementing the UI.

q-and-a.requiredWarning: Готового гайда пока нет, использую исследование. Будьте внимательны: результат будет очень приблизительным, ИИ может ошибаться и додумывать детали. Его нужно сверить с продакшеном.

policies.readScope: Do not load every guide, catalog record, SVG or screenshot. Read one selected route and only records linked to the task.
policies.missingCoverage: Disclose the gap and every material assumption; do not present an invented rule as guide-backed.
policies.unavailableRepository: If neither GitHub content nor a local checkout is available, report that the guide cannot be read and do not claim compliance.
